headline: Companies repower 17 wind farms in Castile and León, with 424.6 MW and an investment of 557 million, one-fifth with public aid
summary: The repowering project covers 17 wind farms totalling 424.6 MW, with a €557 million investment, one-fifth backed by public aid. The region has 409 turbines past 25 years old.
why: Wind repowering extends and upgrades renewable capacity, a major capital expenditure area for Spanish energy companies.
